name: Heaven's Secret 3
source:
Three worlds collide in a war against the God of Darkness. Who is destined to change the course of history, and who will be lost in the abyss of Nonexistence?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Heaven%27s_Secret_3]romance-club.fandom[/url]

三个世界在一场对抗黑暗之神的战争中激烈碰撞。谁注定将改变历史的走向？谁又会迷失于虚无的深渊？
